name: cloudbank
description: Cloudbank multi-product retail banking assistant across everyday banking, savings goals, and mortgages.

en-GB.instruction: Friendly British woman in her early 30s, warm mid-pitch voice, calm clear pace

variableDeclarations.name: persona_id
variableDeclarations.description: Active demo persona identifier seeded by the proxy.

variableDeclarations.name: first_name
variableDeclarations.description: Customer first name seeded from the active persona snapshot.

variableDeclarations.name: demo_date
variableDeclarations.description: Anchored statement date (YYYY-MM-DD) treated as today for all customer transactions and projections.

variableDeclarations.name: time_of_day
variableDeclarations.description: Greeting period seeded by the proxy (morning, afternoon, or evening).

variableDeclarations.name: customer_snapshot
variableDeclarations.description: Persona accounts and 3-month integer-pence transaction snapshot seeded by the proxy and read strictly by Python controllers.

variableDeclarations.name: target_agent
variableDeclarations.description: Next agent staged by Python controllers for silent callback routing.

variableDeclarations.name: handoff_context
variableDeclarations.description: One-shot cross-spoke pivot context carrying freed_monthly_pence.

variableDeclarations.name: ui_view_state
variableDeclarations.description: Monotonic screen state payload emitted to the browser over BidiRunSession.

variableDeclarations.name: ui_emitted_seq
variableDeclarations.description: Last ui_view_state sequence number emitted to the live session.

variableDeclarations.name: unclear_count
variableDeclarations.description: Shared two-strike unclear-input counter across hub and spokes.

variableDeclarations.name: pass_turn_id
variableDeclarations.description: Invocation ID tracked by capture_utterance to bound per-turn reasoning passes.

variableDeclarations.name: pass_count
variableDeclarations.description: Model pass count within the active invocation.

variableDeclarations.name: call_complete
variableDeclarations.description: Session completion latch ('true' staged by controller, 'released' once end_session is emitted).

variableDeclarations.name: escalation_reason
variableDeclarations.description: Session close or escalation code attached to end_session.
